contentList.content: A soul reborn out of sequence, the Novice remembers fragments of another life: the training fields of Rune-Midgard, the climb from first job to second, and the solemn rite before the Valkyrie. Stripped of title, coin, and relic, they awaken in the Forgotten Realms with nothing but discipline and instinct. Their old techniques survive as rough muscle memory, but this world is different, crueler, and stranger. Every battle is a lesson, every companion a new chapter, and every choice a step toward becoming something greater than they were before.
The spiritual reserve used to perform Ragnarok-style techniques.
Novice training from Rune-Midgard. Grants proficiency with Daggers, Shortswords, Clubs, and Shortbows.
Feign death for 4 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points. Usable once per Short Rest.
A close-range emergency treatment. Heal a creature for 1d4 Hit Points. Costs 2 Mana Points.
First Aid improves to 1d6 healing at Novice level 5.
First Aid improves to 1d8 healing at Novice level 9.
When you roll a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw, reroll the die once and use the new result.
